profile.name: Xiaoyu
profile.overview: Xiaoyu is a tricky and evasive stance-based mixup character who excels in slipping past her opponent's attacks in order to land powerful mixups. She is a specialist character who thrives in the hands of players who love spending time in the lab, discovering setups with her many evasive stances and unique move properties.
profile.playstyle: Tricky and evasive stance mix-ups. Phoenix (AOP) shrinks her hurtbox so she slips under highs and some mids (Wavu), back-turned (BT) and Hypnotist (HYP) add more mix-ups, and she wins by making the opponent whiff and launching them. She is tiny with short range, so long-limbed characters can wall her out: play compact and close the gap carefully.
strengths: Queen of Evasion: Phoenix stance shrinks Xiaoyu's hurtbox down to almost comical levels, allowing her to slip under highs and even some mids. Her other stance Hypnotist automatically walks left to bait responses in pressure, and in RDS she has access to a suite of powerful movement options. Effective Xiaoyu players can slip through just about anything.

Godlike Okizeme: Xiaoyu's evasion is even effective against opponent wakeup, and she has many moves with properties useful for rewarding setups. If she pays attention to her opponent's choices, then she can blow them up.
Confusing: Xiaoyu has a lot of moves, and many of them have large decision trees with cancels or stance choices. Opponents can easily lose track of what's about to happen.
Versatile Pokes: Xiaoyu is blessed with an armada of annoying lows and excellent mids. Many of these options are relatively safe on block, while leaving the opponent standing for further pressure.
Great Standing Punishment: Xiaoyu has an excellent standing punishment suite, boasting a wall splatting mid at i12, a heat engager at i13, and she's blessed with the coveted i14 launcher.
weaknesses: Range: Xiaoyu is tiny, and thus needs to play very compact. She can be effectively walled out by characters with longer limbs, like Bryan or Dragunov.
Linear: Xiaoyu's moves don't track lateral movement very well. An agile opponent with good movement can make many of her options more difficult to use safely.
Confusing: Xiaoyu has a lot of moves. Without steady practice, she can lose track of herself and get into trouble of her own making.

Subpar Crouching Punishment: While Xiaoyu's early crouching punishment is good, with a knockdown at i11 and a wall splat at i12, it isn't good enough to make up for her lack of an i13 punish and an i15 launcher.
